problems.problem: Publish order runs against the package dependency graph. Sprint 8 publishes bot-logic before Sprint 9 (core) and Sprint 12 (svg), but bot-logic depends on both through `workspace:*`, and pnpm rewrites that to the exact version at publish. The npm bot-logic release would therefore pin the unfixed core 5.8.0 and svg 4.3.0. BUG-035's own fix names 'discord-worker via bot-logic' as a consumer. The same inversion hits Sprint 9 (core) and Sprint 14 (worker-kit): both publish before Sprint 13 (logger), and both depend on logger, so the BUG-140/141 redaction fixes would not reach their published dependency.
problems.fix: Reorder the package sprints to the dependency order: logger, then core, then svg, then bot-logic. worker-kit goes after logger. Alternatively, state that each dependent package is republished after its dependencies.
